messages:
jon.r: Heads up — my PR to add the migration guide (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482) just failed the docs preview. linkcheck + vale errors. 

ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #482 — linkcheck: 3 broken links, vale: 2 rule violations. See artifact: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/482/logs

ines: Can you paste the specific linkcheck errors? I can fix quick if it's just relative paths.

jon.r: Sure — paste from the log: 
```
LinkCheckError: /guides/migration/old-models -> 404 (target not found)
LinkCheckError: /sdk/python/old-snippet -> 404
LinkCheckError: https://external.example.com/old-ref -> 410
```

jon.r: And vale output: 
```
docs/guides/migration.md:45: Passive voice: "is recommended" (VALE:PreferActive)
docs/guides/migration.md:112: Long sentence (VALE:LongSentences)
```

ines: Cool. I can handle the relative ones. The external 410 we should either update to the archived URL or remove.

sarah: I can take the vale fixes — will rewrite the passive sentences and split the long one. ETA 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: For merge timing — once CI is green we can merge. If we need a hotfix to docs content that blocks a release, we can force-merge after a quick review. Is this blocking any customer-facing release?

jon.r: Not blocking a release; just want to get the guide live before next week's onboarding docs push. No rush.

ines: Fixed two internal links in a new commit (push: 1769994600). Updated paths to canonical slugs.

ci-bot: Re-run queued: docs-preview for PR #482 triggered by push 1769994600

ci-bot: docs-preview failed again — remaining: external link 410 and vale passive voice still flagged (file: docs/guides/migration.md:45)

sarah: I pushed wording change to avoid passive voice and split the long sentence in a follow-up commit (push: 1769994801).

jon.r: Thanks Sarah. I replaced the external link with the archived page (https://web.archive.org/.../old-ref) in a new commit (push: 1769994900) — should resolve the 410.

ci-bot: docs-preview success for PR #482 — all checks green. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/482/preview

jon.r: Nice. Who's up for a quick review so we can merge? @sarah @mike ?

mike: I'll do the review now. Tiny doc changes only.

mike: Reviewed and approved. :white_check_mark: One suggestion inline but not required.

jon.r: Thanks — merging now.

docs-bot: PR #482 merged by jon.r into main. Deployed docs preview will be available in ~5m. :rocket:

jon.r: Follow-up note: I'll open a small linting rule ticket to reduce false positives on the migration guide patterns — vale seems too aggressive for our migration phrasing. I'll add examples for authors.

sarah: Good call. Tag me on the ticket and I'll add a couple suggested rule exceptions.

jon.r: Will do. Closing thread.
